name: Ningyo no Iru Ori
source:
Reunited after eight long years, my ex-lover, who is now a merman somehow, was sitting right there in the bathtub in my own room. His eyes, unchanged after all this time, gleamed with murderous intent. 

This is a story about how to deal with a merman—who happens to look just like my ex-boyfriend from high school—after he suddenly decides to take over my bathroom. He seems hell-bent on taking my life for some inexplicable reason, so now I'll have to try and survive by any means necessary.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10439]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
漫长的八年后重逢时，我的前情人，不知何故现在成了人鱼，就坐在我自己房间的浴缸里。他的双眸，始终没有任何变化，闪烁着杀机。

这是一个关于如何对付一条人鱼的故事——他恰好长得像我高中时的前男友——在他突然决定占领我的浴室后。他似乎出于某种莫名其妙的原因一心想要夺走我的生命，所以现在我必须尝试使用​​任何必要的手段来生存。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10439]Novelgame[/url]]
